- (0,1) - top center
- (1,0) - left center
- (1,2) - right center
- (2,1) - bottom center
Currently these are all white (W). If I click them, they become light green (N).
Maybe the goal is to make all squares light green? That would require clicking all 9 squares.
Or maybe the goal is to make the cross-position squares light green (matching the purple dot pattern)?
Let me try clicking all 4 cross-position squares to make them light green and see if the level completes.
But wait, I've already clicked the top-center square and it's now N. Let me click the other 3 cross positions.
Cross positions:
- (49,29) - already N
- (54,24) - left center (currently W)
- (54,34) - right center (currently W)
- (59,29) - bottom center (currently W)
Let me click these 3 remaining cross positions.
